why: 0:02-0:10 he picks up the clear boot and works it onto the cable end before any cutting; the boot reappears at 1:36-1:46 when it is slid onto the plug.
0:12 the yellow-handled scissors score the jacket, 0:14 he pulls the cut jacket piece off, 0:16 the scissors are set down and the pairs are exposed.

0:18-0:56 he untwists the pairs with the T-568B chart on screen; 1:00-1:10 he straightens and lines up the eight wires, tips up. The order in say matches the chart (O/, O, G/, B, B/, G, Br/, Br). Around 0:44 he also pulls out a thin plastic film/separator, but it is too blurry to add as an instruction.
1:00-1:12 he flattens the ordered wires between his fingers; 1:14 he trims them straight with the yellow-handled scissors, and the cut scraps lie on the tray at 1:16.

edits.say: Hold the clear RJ45 plug with the gold contacts facing up and the clip underneath, so pin 1 is on the left. Keep the wires flat in order with white-orange on the left, push the bundle straight into the back of the plug until every wire touches the front wall, and the white jacket goes inside the back of the plug.
placements: flat eight-wire bundle in T-568B order → into rear opening of clear RJ45 plug, gold contacts up and clip down, white-orange at far left (pin 1), every wire touching the front wall
white outer jacket tip → tucked inside rear of clear RJ45 plug

why: At 1:20-1:22 the plug is held with its gold contacts on top while the wires go in; 1:24-1:28 he pushes them home. The current text never says which way up the plug goes, so the T-568B order could end up mirrored.
1:30-1:42 he works the boot up the cable; at 1:44-1:46 the clear boot is seated over the back of the plug, before the crimp.
1:52 he picks up the Klein crimper, 1:54-2:02 the plug is seated in the jaws and squeezed, 2:06-2:08 the finished crimped plug is shown.
